items.title: 68427_Harry Edison oral history interview
items.q: And then Roland Hanna, he came in after Tommy Flanagan and played with me.

ctx.x: Oh, Elvin took Persip's place, I see.
And Tommy Flanagan. Oh, I had a good band Oh, I really did. And then Roland Hanna, he came in after Tommy Flanagan and played with me. And --
How was he in those days?

items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, he played with me off and on.

ctx.x: Roland played with you for…it wasn’t just that one period. He stayed with you for a while.
Yes, he played with me off and on. Then, after that I went with Josephine Baker.
Can we backtrack and little and discuss how you settled in Los Angeles and how you ended up making this your home.
